how_we_track: Every view is a paper trade priced the day it was added, at the bid plus one third of the gap to the ask. A trade ends only at its target, its stop or its expiry. Put spreads are held to expiry. The "Why we hold this view" line explains our reasoning; sometimes it is better to be lucky than good.
